name: smh_int8_t2-t2-COMMIT
purpose: SAFE hard tile of the smh_attn ENABLE_INT8 packet-ingress adapter (COORD 0ki; GEN2e l13_int8 sets ENABLE_INT8 1 on all 16 SM): cycle-exact with ot_smh_static_int8 (low beat +2, high +3, priced), every pin registered in RTL, one 12-level logic stage, kept selects <=32 loads, no macros. Pin-bound outline (2,105 pins, N in / S out <=4.95 pins/um; PARALLEL compact variant of smh_int8_t1 (216 x 108, higher util)). Pins spread over the FULL N/S faces (pin_ranges + pin_balance), gate-1 review: PPL had clustered them in the middle half.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_smh_int8_tile u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/sm/static/ot_smh_int8_tile.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/smh_int8_t2/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/smh_int8_t2/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/smh_int8_t2 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_smh_int8_tile  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
